form.label: 3. IoT — From Reactive to Proactive
form.description: Turn IoT device telemetry into an early-warning signal instead of a post-mortem, and share the same view with the external service provider.

html.blockquote: "IoT Systeme werden zur Zeit überhaupt nicht proaktiv überwacht, zu 99% reaktiv. Man arbeitet hier mit einem externen Dienstleister zusammen."
html.p: Today, an IoT device (asset tags, environmental sensors, infusion pumps, etc.) is only noticed when it stops working — a ticket to the external managed-service provider is the first signal anyone gets. Device telemetry (battery level, signal strength, last-seen) almost always degrades before it goes fully dark. Centralizing that telemetry in Splunk turns "find out it broke" into "get alerted 2 days before it breaks", and gives the customer and the MSP the same shared view instead of two separate dashboards.

panel.title: Data sources needed to build this for real

ul.li: IoT gateway / platform telemetry — MQTT broker, LoRaWAN network server, or the vendor's cloud API (battery %, RSSI/signal, last-seen heartbeat) per device.
Network access data — which VLAN/SSID/AP the device is on (wireless controller logs), to separate a device problem from a network problem.
MSP ticketing system — ServiceNow/Jira/whatever the external provider uses, via its REST API, so ticket volume and MTTR can be compared against telemetry.
Asset inventory — device type, location/ward, and criticality, so alerts can be prioritized (a dead asset tag is not the same as a dead infusion pump gateway).

search.query: | makeresults | eval "% incidents caught only after the device went dark"=99

panel.title: Devices with degrading telemetry right now (would-be proactive alerts)
Fleet health — battery & connectivity trend (7 days)

search.query: | makeresults count=7 | streamstats count as i | eval Day=strftime(relative_time(now(), "-".(7-i)."d"), "%m-%d") | eval "Asset-Tag-114 battery %"=case(i<=4, 61-(i*2), 1=1, 61-(i*8)) | eval "InfusionGW-22 signal (RSSI dBm, higher=better)"=case(i<=5, -58-(i*1), 1=1, -58-(i*6)) | table Day "Asset-Tag-114 battery %" "InfusionGW-22 signal (RSSI dBm, higher=better)"

panel.title: Devices trending toward failure (would page the MSP before an outage)

search.query: | makeresults count=3 | streamstats count as i | eval Device=case(i=1,"Asset-Tag-114",i=2,"InfusionGW-22",i=3,"EnvSensor-Ward3-07") | eval Signal=case(i=1,"Battery 13% (dropping ~8%/day)",i=2,"RSSI -94 dBm (dropping fast)",i=3,"Last-seen 41 min ago (normally <2 min)") | eval "Days until likely dark"=case(i=1,2,i=2,1,i=3,0) | eval Priority=case(i=1,"Medium",i=2,"High — infusion pump gateway",i=3,"High — already intermittent") | table Device Signal "Days until likely dark" Priority | sort "Days until likely dark"

panel.title: The SPL, once IoT telemetry is onboarded

html.pre: index=iot_telemetry | stats latest(battery_pct) as battery, latest(rssi_dbm) as rssi, latest(_time) as last_seen by device_id | lookup asset_inventory device_id OUTPUT device_type, ward, criticality | eval minutes_dark=round((now()-last_seen)/60,1) | eval risk=case( battery<20 OR rssi<-90 OR minutes_dark>15, "proactive-alert", 1=1, "healthy") | where risk="proactive-alert" | table device_id device_type ward battery rssi minutes_dark criticality
html.p: Share this same search (or a scheduled report of it) with the MSP — one shared signal instead of the customer and the provider each guessing.
